name: maintenance-request-lifecycle
description: Creates a maintenance request and validates initial save and workflow state

doc_metadata.title: Maintenance Request List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to the Maintenance Request list page. Maintenance requests are used to report issues and request corrective or preventive maintenance.

doc_metadata.title: Create New Maintenance Request
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to open the maintenance request form.

steps.value: E2E Test — Leaking pipe in Building A

doc_metadata.title: Fill Form Field
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Test — Leaking pipe in Building A" into the Description field.

doc_metadata.title: Save Maintenance Request
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Save' to submit the maintenance request. The system creates a draft record that can be moved through the approval workflow.

doc_metadata.title: Maintenance Request Details
doc_metadata.caption: The maintenance request has been created. Review the details and use the workflow dropdown to advance the request through its lifecycle.
